match.description: Id of the existing ledger entry this is more evidence for (e.g. TM-004), or "" for a new idea.

title.description: Short name for the tool or change, imperative ("Rebuild registry + screenshot after room edits").

summary.description: What it would do, concretely, in 1-3 sentences.

rationale.description: What it saves or prevents, judged from the evidence.

session.description: The 8-character session id from the digest header.

quote.description: Copied verbatim from that session's digest (a user line, a command, an error). Under 300 characters.

note.description: One line: why this is evidence.

notes.description: Optional: anything about this batch worth the author's attention that is not a tool idea. Empty if none.
